about: What each seeded-bug indexer must produce under `xdrcheck replay`. One row per bug, in the order of the specification's table, plus `none` (the unmodified baseline). `entries` selects what is replayed (default: the entries named under `expect`; ["*"] is the whole corpus); `args` are extra `xdrcheck replay` arguments. Every report row must match an `expect` item by entry, variant, result (class·qualifier) and, when given, a substring of its notes; each item must be matched at least `min` (default 1) and at most `max` (default unlimited) times. An entry named under `expect` that the corpus does not hold yet is listed as pending, never silently passed. `hole` marks an item the harness is known not to meet yet: a mismatch there is reported as a known hole, and fails the run only under XDRCHECK_SELFTEST_STRICT=1.
